title: Agent chat
description: A chat sidebar that talks to your node's `ipfs mcp` agent endpoint. It is off by default. While it is off, nothing is loaded and no request is made. There is no default endpoint: you choose the address.
originAllowlist: The endpoint refuses browser origins it does not list. Before you turn the chat on, add this Web UI's origin to the node's agent.origin_allowlist setting. The list is empty by default.

endpoint.label: Agent endpoint (/agui URL)
endpoint.help: The address `ipfs mcp --http --agui` listens on, ending in /agui. Use https, or http on this machine only.

error.empty: Enter the /agui address of your node.
error.invalid: This is not a valid URL.
error.scheme: Use https, or http on localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1].
error.extras: Remove the username, password, query and fragment.

token.label: Access token
token.help: The bearer token of the node's UI principal. It is saved in this browser profile so you do not enter it again after a reload. Use Forget token to remove it.
token.isSet: A token is saved in this browser profile.

launcher.label: Agent chat
launcher.loadError: The chat could not be loaded. Press the button to try again.

desktopManaged: IPFS Desktop manages the agent chat connection. The endpoint and token are set up by the app, so there is nothing to configure here.
